message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | # | What to Do | How It Works | |---|------------|--------------| | **1. Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. | | **2. Turn Order** | • Play proceeds clockwise (or counterclockwise if a “Reverse” card is played). | | **3. Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches the **color** or **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. | | **4. Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Same as Wild, but next player draws four cards and loses their turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **5. Winning a Turn** | • After playing a card, you may immediately play another if it’s still playable (e.g., you can chain a “Draw Two” after a “Draw Two”). | | **6. Going Out** | • When you play your last card, shout **“Uno!”** (if you’re down to one card).
• If you forget, the next player draws two cards as a penalty. | | **7. Winning the Game** | • The first player to reach **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed score) wins. Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **8. Scoring** | • Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | **Quick Tips** - Keep track of the current color; if you’re out of that color, you can play a Wild or a Wild Draw Four (if you have no other playable card). - Use “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” strategically to block opponents. - Remember to say “Uno!” when you’re down to one card—otherwise you’ll get a penalty. That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to tweak the rules (e.g., “Stacking” or “No Wild Draw Four” variants) to suit your group. Enjoy the game!
